runs.t: EFG Holding seeks to align itself with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), consistently keeping track of how its activities and operations can contribute to realizing individual objectives. We submit yearly Communication on Progress (COP) reports that affirm our continuing commitment to the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC) and annual Transparency Reports as part of our commitment as signatories of the UN Principles of Responsible Investment (PRI). The following table lays out our ESG efforts in 2025 and demonstrates how each one contributes to the SDGs.
